$schema_note: Host-capability manifest for the Shop. The Maker reads this before dispatch to confirm a Specialist's wrapped tool is reachable on the dispatching host, and to resolve a fallback when it isn't. Implementation surface for host_capability_check(specialist, host). Authored 2026-05-30; update in lockstep with the Maker Roster and each Specialist's frontmatter.

host_classes.mac: Loudon's machine. Full tier — MPS GPU, Max/MSP, VCV Rack, Chromium, LaTeX. Everything runs.
host_classes.sandbox: Cowork Linux arm64, no sudo, no GPU. Web specialists, Matplotlib, Mermaid, ffmpeg, Whisper (CPU).
host_classes.cloud: API-reachable services. Currently FLUX (Hugging Face Inference); Midjourney deprecated 2026-05-30 in favour of FLUX.
host_classes.runpod: Rented GPU we own the worker on. Serverless endpoints (scale-to-zero, per-second) and on-demand pods (continuous bill, but full ComfyUI + ControlNet/LoRA). Reachable from any host via HTTPS; solves the no-GPU/quota wall. Serverless for spiky batches, pod for ControlNet/iteration. See [[RunPod GPU Backend]].

Kokoro.fallback_note: Use Loudon's recording when the piece is published as Loudon; otherwise defer to mac.

Whisper.fallback_note: CPU-bound; slow on sandbox but runs.

Stable Audio Open.fallback_note: No substitute. Defer to mac or drop the bed for the tier.

RNBO codebox~ smith.fallback_note: Mac-only by nature; never dispatched off-mac.

VCV Patch Generator.fallback_note: PDL→.vcv emission is host-agnostic; the Rack AUDITION is mac-only.

Midjourney.fallback_note: DEPRECATED 2026-05-30 — too expensive; superseded by FLUX (Hugging Face). Kept in manifest as a lineage record; never dispatch.

FLUX (Hugging Face).fallback_note: Local ComfyUI SDXL when palette/seed/ControlNet matter more than mood fidelity. FLUX-Krea-dev via HF Inference free tier; auth via ~/.cache/huggingface/token or HF_TOKEN env.

ComfyUI.fallback_note: Runs on mac (MPS) and on runpod (proven 2026-06-14: board->serverless FLUX txt2img + a pod 4090 driving FLUX-ControlNet-Union via the hardened transport). Route to runpod when local VRAM/quota is the wall or a self-owned worker is wanted: Piece->serverless, Study/ControlNet->pod. Cloud FLUX-Krea for atmospheric/mood briefs; Mermaid/Matplotlib when the image is really a diagram/chart.

Blender.fallback_note: Offline 3D blocking + posed-scene conditioning passes (pose/depth/canny -> ComfyUI) + Cycles/EEVEE render. Mac-only for now; conditioning is the proven path, Cycles-render/geometry-nodes untested. See [[Blocked, Not Prompted]].

LoRA Trainer.fallback_note: Trains character/subject LoRAs on a rented RunPod GPU (ai-toolkit / kohya); needs an SSH-enabled pod. Rides [[RunPod GPU Backend]]. No local fallback -- defer to runpod.

Matplotlib.fallback_note: Broadly available; also the Manim static-frame fallback.

LaTeX.fallback_note: Typesetting/documents. PDF path (pdflatex/xelatex/latexmk) runs clean on mac. SVG-cutout path (standalone -> dvisvgm) needs the TEXPSHEADERS bridge -- see Manim CE / LaTeX 2026-06-09 gotcha. No content substitute; defer to a TeX Live host. Sandbox TeX Live unconfirmed.

Manim CE.fallback_note: Matplotlib for static math frames; defer motion to mac. manimpango has no aarch64 wheel + needs sudo.

Remotion.fallback_note: Defer to mac; Manim only if content is math not UI.

p5.js.fallback_note: Host-agnostic; authored as static HTML, verified headlessly via a redraw seam.

Observable Plot.fallback_note: Host-agnostic; load d3 before the Plot UMD bundle.

Tone.js.fallback_note: Host-agnostic; in-browser audio confirmation is a human step.

Three.js.fallback_note: Authoring host-agnostic; the deliverable is frame rate, so the GPU-tier check is a HUMAN step on the real deployment target. r128 is the claude.ai-artifact ceiling.

Web Audio Worklet.fallback_note: Zero-dependency per-sample DSP (AudioWorklet); authoring host-agnostic; in-browser audio confirmation is a human step (like Tone.js).

Image-to-3D Smith.fallback_note: STUB — not yet dispatched on a real brief. Four engines: Hi3DGen (primary, watertight), Hunyuan3D-2 (fast fallback), TRELLIS.2 (display-optimized textured GLB), TripoSplat (Gaussian splat lane, NOT a triangle mesh). All run anonymous on HF Spaces today; Piece-tier needs HF token or mac-local. See [[Image-to-3D Smith]] for selection heuristic.
